🚨 TRAFFIC ADVISORY – IPL 2026 🚨

In view of IPL matches at Rajiv Gandhi International Cricket Stadium, Uppal, moderate traffic congestion is expected on key dates including 6th May 2026.

⏰ On 06.05.2026, congestion likely from 12:00 hrs to 24:00 hrs on routes: Nagole–Uppal–Habsiguda & Boduppal–Uppal–Amberpet.

🚛 Heavy vehicles will be diverted at multiple points; commuters are advised to avoid these routes and plan alternate travel.

🚇 Citizens are encouraged to use public transport like RTC buses & Metro Rail for hassle-free movement.

🅿️ Designated parking areas are arranged near the stadium; vehicles without valid passes won’t be allowed inside.

Please cooperate with Traffic Police and plan your journey accordingly.

#TrafficAdvisory #IPL2026 #MalkajgiriPolice #TrafficAlert #StayAlert #PublicSafety

data.text:
Nagsagawa ng joint clearing operations ang mga tauhan ng Traffic and Transport Management Department (TTMD) sa Peacock Street, Brgy. Fairview, bilang tugon sa natanggap na report ng lokal na pamahalaan tungkol sa illegal parking sa mga nasabing lugar.

Inisyuhan din ng Ordinance Violation Receipt (OVR) ang mga sasakyang ilegal na nakaparada sa kalye, na maaaring magdulot ng panganib sa mga siklista at pagbagal ng daloy ng trapiko.

Patuloy ang Quezon City Government sa pagsasagawa ng active monitoring para matiyak ang maayos na daloy ng trapiko at mapanatili ang kaayusan at kaligtasan sa Lungsod Quezon.

Para sa agarang aksyon kaugnay ng kaparehong concern, ipagbigay-alam ito sa amin o tumawag sa Helpline 122.

data.text:
LOOK: Joined by the families of the late Alyssa Alano, several students from University of the Philippines Diliman walked out of their classroom and marched toward the UP Film Center, today, May 5, 2026.

The protest calls for justice for the 19 victims of Negros massacre, which claimed the lives of UP student leader Alyssa Alano. Others were also killed in the military operation in Toboso, Negros Occidental, on April 19, 2026. 

With placards, the protesters wrote “Hustisya para kay Alyssa” and “Justice for Negros 19.”

In a statement the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) maintains that all fatalities were members of the New People's Army (NPA), but the relatives of several victims insist that those killed were civilians. 

Courtesy: Dannyboy Pata

Visit https://t.co/bAMF9JO2Xs for updates.

A fire broke out at the Main Academic Building of Polytechnic University of the Philippines (PUP) in Sta. Mesa, Manila, after a generator exploded at around 2:30 PM on Tuesday. Classes were immediately suspended due to the fire. 

Starting tomorrow, May 6, 2026, classes in the building's East and West Wings will shift to online mode until further notice, PUP announced. | (Photos courtesy of Lalien Avenido, Dexter Flores, Kenjie Obeda/Baliktanaw)
